notes:
Refers to transforming raw materials into a finished or usable form through manufacturing or processing. In modern usage, it is widely used for editing or manipulating digital content such as photos and data.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: food processing
- ⟦{加工|かこう}{食品|しょくひん}→加工食品：06605_kakoushokuhin⟧: processed food
- ⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: image editing
- ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: metalworking
- ⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: processing technology

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to manufacture — focuses on creating finished products, especially in industrial settings
- ⟦{編集|へんしゅう}する→編集する：21991_henshuusuru⟧: to edit — used for editing text, video, or audio content, while ⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧ is more common for image manipulation
- ⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to process; to handle — broader term covering any kind of handling or dealing with something, not limited to physical transformation
